_comment: REAL-LLM (spends money) — end-to-end plan-and-execute with a real provider. No scripted_model_responses, so dispatch.go classifies for real (a clearly-Deliberate task -> PlanWorkflow), the planning turn makes a real ModelCall that must call propose_plan, plan.seed writes PLAN.md, and the checkpoint turns run real ModelCalls too. Verifies SkillDiscover feeds the planning turn (kind='skill' rows under the plan_id), prompt.assemble builds a real prompt, and the plan drives to completion. Run manually: run_scenario.sh real-llm-pipeline. Expensive: 1 planning call + one call per checkpoint.
